item.title: Diljit Dosanjh breaks his own record with 15-date Aura World Tour across North America

item.description: Bollywood icon Saif Ali Khan, known for his sophisticated style, was recently spotted cruising the streets of Mumbai in his latest acquisition: the MG M9 EV.
